description: Photos aériennes 2010 des plages de Charente-Maritime is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Pôle Odatis. 2010 aerial photos of the beaches of Charente-Maritime made for the Observatory of Tourism and Leisure Practices - ECOP (Evolution of Coasts and Practices ) which is a unit of the Federation of Research in Environment for Sustainable Development (FR 3097). Coverage: Pôle Odatis. The portal shows the English title as "2010 aerial photos of the beaches of Charente-Maritime" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Pôle Odatis. Its keywords include Ortho-imagerie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
